summary: Colony Bankcorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, announcing its entry into a merger agreement to acquire First Reliance Bancshares, Inc. (FSRL). Each FSRL share will be converted into the right to receive either $19.75 in cash or 0.94 shares of Colony common stock, subject to proration such that 20% of shares receive cash and 80% receive stock. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction. Expected to close in Q4 2026, the deal is subject to customary conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder elections to gauge the risk-arb spread.
